column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/BuildInputResolverTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 59 automatic, 85 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:each old combined check (code and empty path) is an ASSERT_ERROR plus a path check with the old message; the early return after the first resolve is an ASSERT
ported;note:each old combined check is an ASSERT_ERROR(InvalidOption) followed by its path/item checks (ASSERT where the old test returned early) with the old message
ported;note:the directory standing in options.ini is made with the error_code overload under an ASSERT (the old throwing create_directory aborted the binary)

merged:BuildInputResolver.test_options_ini_edge_cases_through_the_file.EmptyText;note:its per-row check runs once per row: the 35-row table is TEST_P OptionsText in the old order (rows renamed to [A-Za-z0-9] ids, the old sentence kept in every failure message), instantiated as ThroughFile/OptionsText and bundled as one ctest entry; the ok rows compare OptionsArgs field by field (options_fields, each failure names the field), the error rows ASSERT_ERROR(InvalidOption) then EXPECT_EQ on message, item and path, and every row runs instead of the loop carrying on with a pass flag
